title: The X-Files
summary: Iconic sci-fi mystery drama series following FBI Special Agents Fox Mulder and Dana Scully investigating paranormal cases and alien government conspiracies.
facts: Created by Chris Carter and broadcast on the Fox Network.
Popularized tagline 'The Truth Is Out There' and 'I Want to Believe'.
Won 16 Emmy Awards and 5 Golden Globes during its 90s run.

title: Friends
summary: Massively popular NBC sitcom following six friends living in Manhattan (Rachel, Monica, Phoebe, Joey, Chandler, and Ross).
facts: Created by David Crane and Marta Kauffman.
Theme song 'I'll Be There for You' by The Rembrandts hit number 1 on US radio charts.
The 'Rachel' haircut became a worldwide 90s hair trend.

title: Seinfeld
summary: Critically acclaimed NBC sitcom co-created by Larry David and Jerry Seinfeld, famously dubbed 'the show about nothing'.
facts: Followed Jerry Seinfeld, George Costanza, Elaine Benes, and Cosmo Kramer.
Series finale in May 1998 drew 76.3 million viewers in the United States.
Coined legendary pop culture catchphrases like 'Yada yada yada', 'No soup for you!', and 'Festivus'.

title: Twin Peaks
summary: Surreal mystery serial drama created by Mark Frost and David Lynch revolving around the murder of high school student Laura Palmer in a spooky Washington town.
facts: Starred Kyle MacLachlan as FBI Special Agent Dale Cooper.
Features Angelo Badalamenti's iconic haunting synth score.
Central question 'Who killed Laura Palmer?' gripped international television audiences.

title: Pokémon Anime Series
summary: Hit Japanese anime series following young trainer Ash Ketchum and Pikachu on their quest to become a Pokémon Master, sparking global Pokémania.
facts: Adapted from Satoshi Tajiri's Game Boy titles Pokémon Red and Blue.
Famous English theme song 'Gotta Catch 'Em All!' became an instant pop classic.
Sparked immense demand for trading card games and handheld video games.
